Description
The Ford Mustang Mach-E 198kW Select is where iconic Mustang attitude meets modern all-electric refinement. With its 72kWh battery and smooth single-motor rear-wheel-drive setup, it delivers instant torque, effortless acceleration and that uniquely calm EV driving feel. Whether youre gliding through town on one-pedal drive or stretching its legs on the motorway, the Mach-E feels poised, responsive and seriously fun. Inside, its a tech lovers dream. The huge 15.5" SYNC 4A touchscreen puts everything at your fingertips wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, built-in navigation, FordPass Connect, DAB radio and full voice control. A crisp 10.2" digital cluster keeps the essentials clear, while the wireless charging pad and USB ports front and rear keep every device powered. Intelligent adaptive cruise control with stop & go and lane-centring transforms long journeys into laid-back cruising. Comfort is top-tier too. Heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, dual-zone climate control and premium Sensico artificial leather give the cabin a sleek, modern feel. Practicality is excellent thanks to generous space in the rear and the added bonus of a front trunk for extra storage. From the outside, the Mach-E commands attention. LED Mustang signature tail lights, LED reflector headlamps, a bold brace-style grille, privacy glass and those stealthy black 19" alloys with aero covers give it a look thats both muscular and futuristic. Black power-fold mirrors even project the Mustang logo puddle light a small detail that makes every unlock feel special. Safety and confidence come baked in. BLIS with cross-traffic alert, forward collision warning, evasive steering assist, pre-collision assist with mitigation, automated emergency braking, lane-keeping aid and a full 360° camera system all work together to keep every journey protected. The E-Latch keyless entry with keypad access adds real everyday convenience, backed by a Thatcham Cat.1 alarm. Charging is easy with both home and public cables included, plus support for 11kW AC charging and up to 150kW rapid charging when you need a quick top-up. The Mach-E Select blends performance, presence and practicality into a genuinely exciting electric SUV perfect if you want Mustang spirit with zero emissions and maximum modern tech.-The Ford Mustang Mach-E 198kW Select is where iconic Mustang attitude meets modern all-electric refinement.
